name: ui-chemistry-canvas
description: ChemistryCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui chemistry-canvas pattern).

schema.name: ui-chemistry-canvas
schema.description: ChemistryCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui chemistry-canvas pattern).

events.name: Update
events.description: Live scene update; payload carries the current drawable state.

camera.label: Camera
camera.description: 3D only: neutral camera pose ({ mode, zoom, fov, azimuth, target }).

lattice3d.label: Lattice3d
lattice3d.description: A 3D crystal lattice block (simple cubic, BCC, FCC, rock salt, diamond, ...). 3D only.

shadows.label: Shadows
shadows.description: 3D only: enable shadows. Omitted → the host default.

equation.label: Equation
equation.description: Reaction equation text centered at the top of the canvas. 2D only.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Painter: 2D raster (default) or 3D mesh scene via the lazy three.js host.

readouts.label: Readouts
readouts.description: Top-right status chip row, forwarded to LearningCanvas verbatim.

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.description: Extra declarative shapes in canvas pixel coordinates (2D mode only — ignored in 3D).

showGrid.label: Show Grid
showGrid.description: 3D only: show the ground grid (default off).

bondStyle.label: Bond Style
bondStyle.description: Bond line rendering: 'thick' varies stroke width by order (default), 'parallel' draws offset parallel strokes. 2D only.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.description: 3D only: scene light rig as data.

animate.label: Animate
animate.description: 2D only: continuous redraw loop. 3D motion is entity-state driven.

traces.label: Traces
traces.description: Inset sparkline panels, forwarded to LearningCanvas verbatim.
